children: Higher oil prices are one reason behind last week's rise in Treasury yields, says Payden & Rygel in a note. Another reason is that U.S. economic growth remains remarkably resilient despite a series of shocks, it says, pointing to hyperscalers' continued AI-related capital expenditures. Total tech spend is on track to surpass $800 billion in 2026, Payden & Rygel says. While investors have expressed skepticism about the sustainability of capex-driven growth, Payden & Rygel says it has heard similar fears for three years running. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
